```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
  library(scales);  library(knitr); library(kableExtra)
  library(stringr); library(gridExtra); library(ggrepel)
})
if (requireNamespace("pheatmap",quietly=TRUE)) library(pheatmap)
if (requireNamespace("scales",  quietly=TRUE)) library(scales)


# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
safe_read <- function(path, ...) {
  if (!is.null(path) && file.exists(path))
    tryCatch(read.table(path, header=TRUE, sep="\t",
                        check.names=FALSE, ...), error=function(e) NULL)
  else NULL
}

go_bar <- function(go_df, title, fill_low, fill_high, n=20, padj_thr=0.05) {
  if (is.null(go_df) || !any(go_df$p.adjust < padj_thr, na.rm=TRUE)) {
    cat("No significant terms at padj <", padj_thr, "\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  go_df |> filter(p.adjust < padj_thr) |> arrange(p.adjust) |> head(n) |>
    mutate(neg_lp = pmin(-log10(p.adjust), 50),
           Description = str_trunc(Description, 55)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=reorder(Description, neg_lp), y=neg_lp, fill=neg_lp)) +
    geom_col(show.legend=FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label=GeneRatio), hjust=-0.1, size=2.8) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low=fill_low, high=fill_high) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.25))) +
    labs(title=title, x=NULL, y="-log10(BH-adjusted p-value)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=10)
}

# Quality Control

## Trimming (fastp)

```{r qc-trim}
if (!is.null(trim_stats)) {
  trim_stats |>
    mutate(pct_kept=round(reads_after/reads_before*100,1)) |>
    select(sample_id, condition, reads_before, reads_after, pct_kept,
           any_of(c("q30_rate","mean_len_r1"))) |>
    kable(caption="Per-sample trimming statistics (fastp). Adapter auto-detection; Q20 quality filter; minimum length 36bp. pct_kept: fraction of reads passing all filters.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"))
}

```{r pca-plot, fig.height=5, fig.width=7, fig.cap="PCA of samples based on top 500 most variable genes (log2 normalised counts). PC1 and PC2 percentages indicate variance explained. Samples coloured by condition."}
if (!is.null(pca_coords)) {
  ggplot(pca_coords, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=condition, label=sample_id)) +
    geom_point(size=5, alpha=0.9) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size=3.5, show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values=col_cond, na.value="grey60") +
    labs(title="PCA — Top 500 most variable genes",
         x=paste0("PC1 (", round(var(pca_coords$PC1)/sum(apply(pca_coords[,c("PC1","PC2")],2,var))*100,1),"%)"),
         y="PC2", color="Condition") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=13) + theme(legend.position="top")
} else {
  cat("PCA not available — run m08b_qc_plots.R first
")
}
```

```{r corr-heatmap, fig.height=5, fig.width=6, fig.cap="Sample-sample Pearson correlation matrix based on log2 normalised counts. Values close to 1 indicate high similarity; replicates within the same condition should cluster together."}
if (!is.null(norm_counts) && ncol(norm_counts) >= 2) {
  nc_log <- log2(as.matrix(norm_counts) + 1)
  cor_mat <- cor(nc_log, method="pearson")

  ann_df <- data.frame(Condition=conditions[colnames(cor_mat)],
                       row.names=colnames(cor_mat))
  known_conds <- unique(ann_df$Condition[!is.na(ann_df$Condition) &
                                          ann_df$Condition %in% names(col_cond)])
  use_ann <- length(known_conds) > 0
  ann_colors <- if (use_ann) list(Condition=col_cond[known_conds]) else list()

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    cor_mat,
    color=colorRampPalette(c("#2C3E50","#85C1E9","white"))(100),
    annotation_col=if (use_ann) ann_df else NA,
    annotation_row=if (use_ann) ann_df else NA,
    annotation_colors=if (use_ann) ann_colors else list(),
    display_numbers=TRUE, number_format="%.3f", fontsize_number=9,
    main="Sample-sample Pearson correlation"
  )
} else {
  cat("Correlation heatmap not available
")
}
```

```{r rna-landscape-data, include=FALSE}
# ── Data prep for RNA biotype composition plots ───────────────────────────────
classify_bt <- function(gt) case_when(
  gt=="protein_coding"                               ~ "Protein-coding",
  gt=="lncRNA"                                       ~ "lncRNA",
  grepl("pseudogene",gt)                             ~ "Pseudogene",
  gt %in% c("miRNA","snRNA","snoRNA","scaRNA","rRNA")~ "Small RNA",
  gt=="misc_RNA"                                     ~ "misc_RNA",
  gt=="TEC"                                          ~ "TEC",
  grepl("^IG_|^TR_", gt)                             ~ "IG/TR genes",
  TRUE                                               ~ "Unannotated"
)
classify_macro <- function(fid) case_when(
  grepl("^Alu|^MIR|SINE",    fid, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "SINE (Alu/MIR)",
  grepl("^L1|^L2|^CR1|LINE", fid, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "LINE (L1/L2)",
  grepl("^LTR|^MLT|^THE|^MER[0-9]|^HERV|^ERV|LTR",
        fid, ignore.case=TRUE)                       ~ "LTR/ERV",
  grepl("^Tigger|^Charlie|^hAT|^Mariner|^MER[A-Z]|DNA",
        fid, ignore.case=TRUE)                       ~ "DNA transposon",
  grepl("^SVA", fid, ignore.case=TRUE)               ~ "SVA",
  TRUE                                               ~ "Other TE"
)

rna_plot_data <- NULL
if (!is.null(norm_counts) && !is.null(gene_map) && length(conditions)>0) {
  cat_map_vec <- setNames(classify_bt(gene_map$gene_type), gene_map$gene_id)
  common_g    <- intersect(rownames(norm_counts), names(cat_map_vec))
  sids        <- intersect(colnames(norm_counts), names(conditions))

  make_pct_summ <- function(rows_list) {
    bind_rows(rows_list) |>
      pivot_longer(-category, names_to="sample_id", values_to="total") |>
      filter(sample_id %in% names(conditions)) |>
      group_by(sample_id) |> mutate(pct=total/sum(total)*100) |> ungroup() |>
      mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id]) |>
      group_by(category, condition) |>
      summarise(mean_pct=mean(pct), sd_pct=sd(pct), .groups="drop")
  }

  bt_totals <- norm_counts[common_g, sids, drop=FALSE] |>
    as.data.frame() |> tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
    mutate(cat=cat_map_vec[gene_id]) |> filter(!is.na(cat)) |>
    group_by(cat) |> summarise(across(all_of(sids), sum), .groups="drop") |>
    rename(category=cat)

  rs_vec <- setNames(rep(0.0,length(sids)), sids)
  for (d in list(te_counts, sat_counts)) {
    if (!is.null(d)) {
      nc <- sapply(d,is.numeric); sc <- intersect(colnames(d)[nc],sids)
      if (length(sc)>0) rs_vec[sc] <- rs_vec[sc] + colSums(d[,sc,drop=FALSE])
    }
  }
  rs_agg <- data.frame(category="RS (TE+Satellite)", as.data.frame(t(rs_vec)))

  # Microbial reads from M20 (Kraken2 classified, non-human)
  # Use meta_summary: total classified reads minus Homo sapiens
  micro_agg <- NULL
  if (!is.null(meta_summary) && "total_reads" %in% colnames(meta_summary)) {
    micro_vec <- setNames(rep(0.0, length(sids)), sids)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(meta_summary))) {
      sid <- meta_summary$sample_id[i]
      if (sid %in% sids) {
        # Microbial = classified reads (already excludes unclassified)
        # We use classified count as proxy for microbial signal
        # (Homo sapiens in this context = reads mapping back to human from unmapped)
        micro_vec[sid] <- as.numeric(meta_summary$classified[i])
      }
    }
    if (sum(micro_vec) > 0)
      micro_agg <- data.frame(category="Microbial",
                               as.data.frame(t(micro_vec)))
  }

  circ_agg <- NULL
  if (!is.null(circ_counts)) {
    nc <- sapply(circ_counts,is.numeric); sc <- intersect(colnames(circ_counts)[nc],sids)
    if (length(sc)>0)
      circ_agg <- data.frame(category="circRNA",
                              as.data.frame(t(colSums(circ_counts[,sc,drop=FALSE]))))
  }

  pct_agg <- make_pct_summ(c(
    split(bt_totals, bt_totals$category) |>
      lapply(function(x){x$category<-x$category[1];x}),
    list(rs_agg, circ_agg, micro_agg)
  ))
  cat_ord_a <- c("Protein-coding","lncRNA","Pseudogene","Small RNA",
                 "misc_RNA","TEC","IG/TR genes","Unannotated","Microbial",
                 "RS (TE+Satellite)","circRNA")
  pct_agg$category <- factor(pct_agg$category,
    levels=rev(cat_ord_a[cat_ord_a %in% pct_agg$category]))

  # Detail rows (no protein-coding)
  detail_rows <- list()
  for (cat_nm in c("lncRNA","Pseudogene","Small RNA","misc_RNA","TEC","IG/TR genes","Unannotated")) {
    gs <- intersect(names(cat_map_vec)[cat_map_vec==cat_nm], rownames(norm_counts))
    if (length(gs)>0) {
      tv <- colSums(norm_counts[gs, sids, drop=FALSE])
      detail_rows[[cat_nm]] <- data.frame(category=cat_nm, as.data.frame(t(tv)))
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(te_counts)) {
    nc <- sapply(te_counts,is.numeric); sc <- intersect(colnames(te_counts)[nc],sids)
    fids <- te_counts[,1]
    for (mac in unique(classify_macro(fids))) {
      sel <- classify_macro(fids)==mac
      if (any(sel)&&length(sc)>0) {
        tv <- colSums(te_counts[sel,sc,drop=FALSE])
        detail_rows[[mac]] <- data.frame(category=mac, as.data.frame(t(tv)))
      }
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(sat_counts)) {
    nc <- sapply(sat_counts,is.numeric); sc <- intersect(colnames(sat_counts)[nc],sids)
    if (length(sc)>0) {
      tv <- colSums(sat_counts[,sc,drop=FALSE])
      detail_rows[["Satellite"]] <- data.frame(category="Satellite", as.data.frame(t(tv)))
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(circ_counts)) {
    nc <- sapply(circ_counts,is.numeric); sc <- intersect(colnames(circ_counts)[nc],sids)
    if (length(sc)>0) {
      tv <- colSums(circ_counts[,sc,drop=FALSE])
      detail_rows[["circRNA"]] <- data.frame(category="circRNA", as.data.frame(t(tv)))
    }
  }
  pct_det <- make_pct_summ(detail_rows)
  cat_ord_b <- pct_det |> group_by(category) |>
    summarise(m=mean(mean_pct)) |> arrange(desc(m)) |> pull(category)
  pct_det$category <- factor(pct_det$category, levels=rev(cat_ord_b))

  rna_plot_data <- list(pct_agg=pct_agg, pct_det=pct_det)
}

make_rna_panel <- function(df, log_scale, fmt, title, y_label) {
  max_y <- max(df$mean_pct + df$sd_pct, na.rm=TRUE)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=category, y=pmax(mean_pct,1e-6), fill=condition)) +
    geom_col(position=position_dodge(0.8), width=0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin=pmax(mean_pct-sd_pct,1e-6), ymax=pmax(mean_pct+sd_pct,1e-6)),
      position=position_dodge(0.8), width=0.3, linewidth=0.4) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_cond) +
    labs(title=title, x=NULL, y=y_label, fill=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11) + theme(legend.position="top")
  if (log_scale) {
    p + scale_y_log10(
          breaks=c(1e-5,1e-4,1e-3,0.01,0.1,1,10,100),
          labels=c("0.00001%","0.0001%","0.001%","0.01%","0.1%","1%","10%","100%"),
          expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.55))) +
      geom_text(aes(y=pmax(mean_pct+sd_pct,1e-5)*2,
                    label=sprintf(fmt, mean_pct)),
                position=position_dodge(0.8), hjust=0, size=3.2)
  } else {
    p + scale_y_continuous(
          labels=function(x) paste0(x,"%"),
          expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.45))) +
      geom_text(aes(y=pmax(mean_pct+sd_pct,mean_pct*1.02) + max_y*0.02,
                    label=sprintf(fmt, mean_pct)),
                position=position_dodge(0.8), hjust=0, size=3.2)
  }
}

# Differential Expression — Canonical Genes

## Summary

```{r de-summary}
if (!is.null(de_genes)) {
  n_up   <- sum(!is.na(de_genes$padj) & de_genes$padj<padj_thr &
                de_genes$log2FoldChange > lfc_thr)
  n_down <- sum(!is.na(de_genes$padj) & de_genes$padj<padj_thr &
                de_genes$log2FoldChange < -lfc_thr)
  cat(sprintf(
    "Tested: **%s** genes  |  Up: **%d**  |  Down: **%d**  |  Not significant: **%d**\n\n",
    format(nrow(de_genes),big.mark=","), n_up, n_down,
    nrow(de_genes)-n_up-n_down))
}
```

## Volcano Plot

```{r volcano, fig.cap="Volcano plot of canonical gene differential expression (DESeq2). Each point is one gene. LFC values are ashr-shrunken. Top differentially expressed genes (by |LFC| × -log10(padj)) are labelled with their gene symbol. Dashed lines: LFC and padj thresholds."}
if (!is.null(de_genes) && nrow(de_genes)>0) {
  de_plot <- de_genes |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) |>
    mutate(
      neg_lp  = pmin(-log10(padj + 1e-300), 50),
      lfc_cap = pmax(pmin(log2FoldChange, 15), -15),
      status  = case_when(
        padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange >  lfc_thr ~ "Up",
        padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange < -lfc_thr ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      gene_name_label = gene_names[gene_id],
      label_score = abs(log2FoldChange) * neg_lp
    )

  # Top genes to label
  top_label <- de_plot |>
    filter(status != "NS") |>
    arrange(desc(label_score)) |>
    head(15)
  if (nrow(top_label)==0) {
    top_label <- de_plot |> arrange(desc(label_score)) |> head(15)
  }

  ggplot(de_plot, aes(x=lfc_cap, y=neg_lp, color=status)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.35, size=0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr),
               linetype="dashed", color="grey30", linewidth=0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(padj_thr),
               linetype="dashed", color="grey30", linewidth=0.4) +
    geom_label_repel(data=top_label,
                     aes(label=ifelse(!is.na(gene_name_label) &
                                        gene_name_label!="",
                                      gene_name_label, gene_id)),
                     size=2.8, max.overlaps=20,
                     box.padding=0.3, min.segment.length=0.2,
                     show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values=c("Up"=col_up,"Down"=col_down,"NS"=col_ns),
      guide=guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=2.5,alpha=1))) +
    labs(title=sprintf("Volcano — %s vs %s", p$treatment, p$control),
         x="log2 Fold Change (ashr-shrunken, capped ±15)",
         y="-log10(BH-adjusted p-value, capped at 50)",
         color=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
    theme(legend.position="top")
}
```

## DE Genes Heatmap

```{r de-heatmap, fig.height=8, fig.width=7, fig.cap="Heatmap of top 50 differentially expressed genes (z-score of log2 normalised counts). Red = upregulated in treatment; blue = downregulated. Hierarchical clustering reveals co-regulated gene groups."}
if (!is.null(de_genes) && !is.null(norm_counts)) {
  top_de <- de_genes |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05, abs(log2FoldChange) > 1) |>
    arrange(padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) |>
    head(50)

  if (nrow(top_de) < 3) {
    cat(sprintf("Only %d significant DE genes — heatmap requires at least 3.
",
                nrow(top_de)))
    cat("With full-depth data, this section will show a z-score heatmap of top 50 DE genes.
")
  } else {
    gid_col  <- if ("gene_id" %in% colnames(top_de)) "gene_id" else colnames(top_de)[ncol(top_de)]
    gids     <- top_de[[gid_col]]
    nc_log   <- log2(as.matrix(norm_counts) + 1)
    common_g <- intersect(gids, rownames(nc_log))
    mat_z    <- t(scale(t(nc_log[common_g,,drop=FALSE])))
    rownames(mat_z) <- label_gene(rownames(mat_z))

    ann_col <- data.frame(Condition=conditions[colnames(mat_z)], row.names=colnames(mat_z))
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      mat_z,
      color=colorRampPalette(c("#2980B9","white","#E74C3C"))(100),
      annotation_col=ann_col,
      annotation_colors=list(Condition=col_cond[unique(ann_col$Condition)]),
      main=sprintf("Top %d DE genes (z-score)", nrow(mat_z)),
      fontsize_row=max(5, 10 - nrow(mat_z)/10)
    )
  }
}

# Differential Expression — Repetitive Sequences

> **Terminology:** "Repetitive Sequences" (RS) refers to all repeat-derived transcripts quantified by MOSAIC: **Transposable Elements** (TE: LINEs, SINEs, LTR retrotransposons/ERVs, DNA transposons, SVA) and **Satellite sequences** (tandem repeats). Quantification uses DFAM 3.9 consensus pseudochromosomes (Bowtie2) for family-level counts, and RepeatMasker hg38 coordinates (TEtranscripts, pysam) for locus-level analysis.

## Top Expressed TE Families

```{r te-top, fig.height=7, fig.cap="Top expressed TE families ordered by total fragment count (all samples, highest first). Left: combined across all samples. Right: mean fragment counts per condition (mean +/- SD), same family order. Fragment counts: deduplicated junction reads mapped to DFAM 3.9 consensus pseudochromosomes (Bowtie2 --very-sensitive-local)."}
if (!is.null(te_counts)) {
  num_cols <- sapply(te_counts, is.numeric)
  fam_ids  <- te_counts[, 1]
  te_mat   <- as.matrix(te_counts[, num_cols, drop=FALSE])

  top_te <- data.frame(family_id=fam_ids, total=rowSums(te_mat)) |>
    arrange(desc(total))
  top30  <- top_te |> head(30)
  fam_lev <- rev(top30$family_id)  # factor levels for correct order

  p_all <- ggplot(top30, aes(x=factor(family_id, levels=fam_lev), y=total)) +
    geom_col(fill="#8E44AD", alpha=0.85) + coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=comma) +
    labs(title="All samples combined", x=NULL, y="Total fragment counts") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=9)

  if (length(conditions)>0) {
    sids_te <- intersect(colnames(te_mat), names(conditions))
    te_long <- data.frame(family_id=fam_ids, te_counts[, sids_te, drop=FALSE]) |>
      pivot_longer(-family_id, names_to="sample_id", values_to="count") |>
      mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id]) |>
      filter(family_id %in% top30$family_id)

    te_cond <- te_long |> group_by(family_id, condition) |>
      summarise(mean_c=mean(count), sd_c=sd(count), .groups="drop") |>
      mutate(family_id=factor(family_id, levels=fam_lev))

    p_cond <- ggplot(te_cond, aes(x=family_id, y=mean_c+1, fill=condition)) +
      geom_col(position=position_dodge(width=0.8), width=0.7) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=pmax(mean_c-sd_c,0)+1, ymax=mean_c+sd_c+1),
                    position=position_dodge(width=0.8), width=0.3, linewidth=0.4) +
      coord_flip() + scale_y_log10(labels=comma) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=col_cond) +
      labs(title="Top 30 TE families — mean +/- SD per condition", x=NULL,
           y="Mean counts+1 (log10)", fill=NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size=9) + theme(legend.position="top")

    print(p_cond)
  } else {
    print(p_all)
  }
}
```

## TE Expression per Sample and Condition

```{r te-by-condition, fig.height=6, fig.cap="Fragment counts for the top 20 expressed TE families, per sample (left) and as mean per condition (right). Bars are ordered by total expression (highest first). Log10 scale is used given the wide dynamic range of TE family counts. Error bars (right panel): standard deviation across samples within each condition."}
if (!is.null(te_counts) && length(conditions)>0) {
  num_cols <- sapply(te_counts, is.numeric)
  fam_ids  <- te_counts[, 1]
  sids_te  <- intersect(colnames(te_counts)[num_cols], names(conditions))

  te_long <- data.frame(family_id=fam_ids,
                         te_counts[, sids_te, drop=FALSE]) |>
    pivot_longer(-family_id, names_to="sample_id", values_to="count") |>
    mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id])

  # Top 20 by total (correct order)
  top20_fam <- te_long |>
    group_by(family_id) |> summarise(tot=sum(count)) |>
    slice_max(tot, n=20) |> arrange(desc(tot)) |> pull(family_id)

  te20 <- te_long |> filter(family_id %in% top20_fam) |>
    mutate(family_id=factor(family_id, levels=rev(top20_fam)))

  p1 <- ggplot(te20, aes(x=family_id, y=count+1, fill=condition)) +
    geom_col(position="dodge") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_log10(labels=comma) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_cond) +
    labs(title="Per sample", x=NULL, y="Counts+1 (log10)", fill=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=8.5) +
    theme(legend.position="top")

  # Mean ± SD per condition (correct order)
  te20_summ <- te20 |>
    group_by(family_id, condition) |>
    summarise(mean_c=mean(count), sd_c=sd(count), .groups="drop")

  p2 <- ggplot(te20_summ, aes(x=family_id, y=mean_c+1, fill=condition)) +
    geom_col(position=position_dodge(width=0.8), width=0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=pmax(mean_c-sd_c,0)+1, ymax=mean_c+sd_c+1),
                  position=position_dodge(width=0.8), width=0.3, linewidth=0.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_log10(labels=comma) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_cond) +
    labs(title="Mean ± SD per condition", x=NULL,
         y="Mean counts+1 (log10)", fill=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=8.5) +
    theme(legend.position="top")

  grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol=2)
}
```

## RS Expression by Macrocategory

```{r te-macro, fig.cap="Repetitive sequence (RS) expression aggregated by macrocategory, per condition. Mean ± SD fragment counts per condition. Numbers above bars: distinct families detected. Macrocategory assignment uses DFAM family name heuristics: SINE (Alu, MIR), LINE (L1, L2, CR1), LTR/ERV (HERV, MLT, THE, MER[0-9]), DNA transposon (Tigger, Charlie, hAT, Mariner), SVA (SINE-VNTR-Alu), Satellite (from separate pseudochromosome index). Note: ERV and HERV elements are a subset of the LTR/ERV category."}
if (!is.null(te_counts) && length(conditions)>0) {
  num_cols <- sapply(te_counts, is.numeric)
  fam_ids  <- te_counts[, 1]
  sids_te  <- intersect(colnames(te_counts)[num_cols], names(conditions))

  classify_macro <- function(fid) case_when(
    grepl("^Alu|^MIR|SINE",      fid, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "SINE",
    grepl("^L1|^L2|^CR1|LINE",   fid, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "LINE",
    grepl("^LTR|^MLT|^THE|^MER[0-9]|^HERV|^ERV|LTR",
          fid, ignore.case=TRUE)                         ~ "LTR/ERV",
    grepl("^Tigger|^Charlie|^hAT|^Mariner|^MER[A-Z]|DNA",
          fid, ignore.case=TRUE)                         ~ "DNA transposon",
    grepl("^SVA",                fid, ignore.case=TRUE)  ~ "SVA",
    TRUE                                                 ~ "Other TE"
  )

  te_macro <- data.frame(family_id=fam_ids,
                          macro=classify_macro(fam_ids),
                          te_counts[, sids_te, drop=FALSE]) |>
    pivot_longer(-c(family_id,macro), names_to="sample_id", values_to="count") |>
    mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id]) |>
    filter(!is.na(condition))

  # Add satellites
  if (!is.null(sat_counts)) {
    sat_num <- sapply(sat_counts, is.numeric)
    sat_sids <- intersect(colnames(sat_counts)[sat_num], names(conditions))
    sat_macro <- data.frame(family_id=sat_counts[,1], macro="Satellite",
                             sat_counts[, sat_sids, drop=FALSE]) |>
      pivot_longer(-c(family_id,macro), names_to="sample_id", values_to="count") |>
      mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id]) |>
      filter(!is.na(condition))
    te_macro <- bind_rows(te_macro, sat_macro)
  }

  macro_summ <- te_macro |>
    group_by(macro, condition, sample_id) |>
    summarise(s_total=sum(count), n_fam=n_distinct(family_id), .groups="drop") |>
    group_by(macro, condition) |>
    summarise(mean_total=mean(s_total), sd_total=sd(s_total),
              n_fam=mean(n_fam), .groups="drop")

  # Single n label per macro (same across conditions)
  n_label <- macro_summ |> group_by(macro) |>
    summarise(n_fam=round(mean(n_fam)), y=max(mean_total+sd_total)*1.15, .groups="drop")

  ggplot(macro_summ,
         aes(x=reorder(macro,-mean_total), y=mean_total, fill=condition)) +
    geom_col(position=position_dodge(width=0.8), width=0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=pmax(mean_total-sd_total,0),
                      ymax=mean_total+sd_total),
                  position=position_dodge(width=0.8),
                  width=0.3, linewidth=0.5) +
    geom_text(data=n_label,
              aes(x=reorder(macro,-y), y=y,
                  label=paste0("n=",n_fam), fill=NULL),
              vjust=0, size=3, color="grey30", inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=comma, expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.2))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_cond) +
    labs(title="RS expression by macrocategory — mean ± SD per condition",
         subtitle="Numbers above bars = mean distinct families detected",
         x=NULL, y="Total fragment counts (mean across samples)",
         fill="Condition") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=25,hjust=1))
}
```

```{r te-de, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(te_de) && nrow(te_de)>0) {
  # If all padj values are identical (common with n=2), sort by pvalue
  all_padj_equal <- length(unique(na.omit(te_de$padj))) <= 2
  te_show <- te_de |>
    filter(!is.na(padj)) |>
    arrange(if(all_padj_equal) pvalue else padj) |>
    select(family_id, any_of(c("baseMean","log2FoldChange",
                                "log2FoldChange_shrunk","pvalue","padj"))) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric),~round(.,4)))

  rows_html <- apply(te_show, 1, function(r) {
    paste0('<tr class="tede-row">',
           paste0('<td>', r, '</td>', collapse=""), '</tr>')
  })
  cat('<p style="font-size:0.85em;color:#555">TE families ordered by unadjusted p-value when all BH-adjusted p-values are equal (common with n=2 per group; BH correction collapses to a single value). When n is sufficient, families are ordered by padj. DESeq2, independentFiltering=FALSE; size factors from stable canonical genes.</p>')
  cat('<div class="table-scroll"><table class="table table-striped table-condensed"',
      ' style="font-size:11px">')
  cat('<thead><tr>',
      paste0('<th>', colnames(te_show), '</th>', collapse=""),
      '</tr></thead><tbody>')
  cat(rows_html, sep="\n")
  cat('</tbody></table></div>')
  cat('<script>document.querySelectorAll(".tede-row").forEach(function(r,i){
        if(i>=20) r.style.display="none";});</script>')
}
```

## TE Age Analysis (M11c)

```{r te-age-landscape, fig.height=5, fig.width=10, fig.cap="TE age landscape: distribution of RepeatMasker substitution divergence per macrocategory. Low divergence = recently inserted (young/active); high divergence = ancient insertions. SVA elements show the youngest profile, consistent with ongoing retrotransposition in humans."}
if (!is.null(te_age_summary)) {
  te_age_summary |>
    mutate(macro=reorder(macro, mean_div)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=macro, y=mean_div, fill=macro)) +
    geom_col(show.legend=FALSE, alpha=0.85) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_div-sd_div, ymax=mean_div+sd_div),
                  width=0.3, linewidth=0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.1f%%", mean_div)),
              hjust=-0.2, size=3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_macro) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.2))) +
    labs(title="Mean divergence from TE consensus sequence by macrocategory",
         subtitle="Proxy for insertion age: lower = younger/more recently active",
         x=NULL, y="Mean divergence from consensus (%)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
} else {
  cat("TE age data not available — run M11c first.
")
}
```

```{r te-age-de, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Correlation between TE family age (mean divergence from consensus) and differential expression (log2FC tumor vs normal). Point size proportional to number of genomic loci. Labels indicate families with significant expression changes."}
if (!is.null(te_age_de_tbl) && nrow(te_age_de_tbl) >= 5) {
  lfc_col  <- grep("log2", colnames(te_age_de_tbl), value=TRUE)[1]
  pval_col <- if ("pvalue" %in% colnames(te_age_de_tbl)) "pvalue" else "padj"

  te_age_de_tbl |>
    rename(lfc=all_of(lfc_col), pval=all_of(pval_col)) |>
    mutate(sig=pval < 0.05,
           label=ifelse(sig & abs(lfc) > 1, family_id, NA)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=mean_div, y=lfc, color=macro, size=n_loci)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label=label), size=2.8,
                              max.overlaps=15, show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values=col_macro) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(2,8), name="# loci") +
    labs(title="TE age vs expression change",
         x="Mean divergence from consensus (%) — proxy for age",
         y=sprintf("log2FC (%s / %s)", p$treatment, p$control),
         color="TE class") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
} else {
  cat("TE age vs DE data not available or insufficient families.
")
}
```

# GO and Pathway Enrichment

> Over-Representation Analysis (ORA, clusterProfiler). Background universe for canonical genes: all expressed genes (baseMean>0). Background for TE host genes: genes with ≥1 expressed TE locus in their gene body (RepeatMasker M11 intersection — 51,934 genes), providing a TE-specific unbiased background. Multiple testing: Benjamini-Hochberg (BH). Gene set size: 10–500.

## Canonical Genes — GO and Pathway Enrichment

> GO and pathway ORA (Over-Representation Analysis) run separately on **up-regulated** genes, **down-regulated** genes, and **all DE genes** combined. Select the tab of interest. Background universe = all expressed genes (baseMean > 5). BH-adjusted p-value threshold shown in each plot.

## TE Host Genes — GO Enrichment

> TE host genes: genes whose annotated body overlaps ≥1 RepeatMasker hg38 TE locus (bedtools intersect ≥10% overlap; M11). The GO background universe is restricted to these 51,934 host genes, making the enrichment specific to the TE-hosting gene context.

### TE Host — Biological Process

```{r go-te-bp, fig.cap="GO Biological Process terms enriched among DE TE host genes, using a TE host-specific background universe (51,934 genes with ≥1 overlapping TE locus, RepeatMasker hg38, M11). Using this restricted universe avoids overestimation of enrichment that would occur with all human genes as background."}
go_bar(go_te_bp, "GO BP — TE host genes (rmsk universe)",
       "#ABEBC6","#1E8449", padj_thr=padj_thr)
```

### TE Host — Molecular Function

```{r go-te-mf, fig.cap="GO Molecular Function terms enriched among DE TE host genes (TE-specific universe). MF enrichment among TE hosts can reveal whether TE-harbouring genes are disproportionately involved in specific biochemical activities, linking TE distribution to gene function."}

       "#A9DFBF","#117A65", padj_thr=padj_thr)
```

## TE Genomic Distribution

```{r te-genomic, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Top 30 genes ranked by TE insertion density in their gene body among DE TE host genes (TE loci per kb of gene body). Only genes that are both differentially expressed AND host at least one TE locus are shown. Density normalisation corrects for gene length bias. Colour indicates TE macrocategory with the highest density per gene."}
if (!is.null(te_host) && !is.null(de_genes)) {
  # Get DE gene IDs
  gid_col_de  <- colnames(de_genes)[ncol(de_genes)]
  de_gene_ids <- de_genes[[gid_col_de]][!is.na(de_genes$padj) &
                                         de_genes$padj < padj_thr]

  if (length(de_gene_ids) == 0) {
    de_gene_ids <- character(0)
  }

  # Join DE genes with TE host table
  te_de_host <- te_host |>
    filter(gene_id %in% de_gene_ids) |>
    mutate(
      gene_name   = gene_names[gene_id],
      label       = ifelse(!is.na(gene_name) & gene_name!="", gene_name, gene_id),
      n_te_loci   = if ("n_te_loci"    %in% colnames(te_host)) n_te_loci else
                    if ("te_count"     %in% colnames(te_host)) te_count else 1L,
      gene_len_kb = if ("gene_length"  %in% colnames(te_host)) gene_length/1000 else NA_real_,
      dominant_macro = if ("dominant_macro" %in% colnames(te_host)) dominant_macro else
                       if ("te_class"       %in% colnames(te_host)) te_class else "Other TE",
      te_density  = ifelse(!is.na(gene_len_kb) & gene_len_kb > 0,
                           n_te_loci / gene_len_kb, NA_real_)
    )

  if (nrow(te_de_host) == 0) {
    cat("No DE TE host genes found at current thresholds.
")
    cat(sprintf("DE genes: %d | TE host genes: %d
",
                length(de_gene_ids), nrow(te_host)))
  } else {
    # Use n_te_loci if density not available
    sort_col <- if (all(is.na(te_de_host$te_density))) "n_te_loci" else "te_density"

    top30 <- te_de_host |>
      arrange(desc(.data[[sort_col]])) |>
      head(30)

    y_lab <- if (sort_col == "te_density") "TE loci per kb of gene body" else
             "Number of TE loci"
    title_sfx <- if (sort_col == "te_density") "(density-normalised)" else
                 "(raw loci count - gene length unavailable)"

    ggplot(top30, aes(x=reorder(label, .data[[sort_col]]),
                       y=.data[[sort_col]], fill=dominant_macro)) +
      geom_col() +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_manual(values=col_macro, na.value="#95A5A6",
                        name="Dominant TE") +
      labs(title=sprintf("Top 30 DE TE host genes %s", title_sfx),
           subtitle=sprintf("DE genes (padj<%.2f) with >=1 TE in gene body | %d genes total",
                            padj_thr, nrow(te_de_host)),
           x=NULL, y=y_lab) +
      theme_minimal(base_size=11)
  }
} else {
  cat("TE host gene data not available (te_host_genes.tsv from M11).
")
}
```

```{r fisher-enrichment}
if (!is.null(te_enrich_fisher) && nrow(te_enrich_fisher) > 0) {
  te_enrich_fisher |>
    mutate(
      sig = ifelse(pvalue < 0.05, "yes", "no"),
      pvalue = formatC(pvalue, digits=4, format="g"),
      odds_ratio = round(odds_ratio, 2)
    ) |>
    select(Analysis=analysis, `DE with TE`=n_DE_with, `DE total`=n_DE_total,
           `BG with TE`=n_bg_with, `BG total`=n_bg_total,
           OR=odds_ratio, `p-value`=pvalue, Significant=sig) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="Fisher's exact test: TE enrichment in DE genes vs background (expressed genes, baseMean>5). OR>1 = DE genes enriched for TE insertions.",
                 align="lrrrrrrc")
} else cat("Fisher test results not available.
")
```

```{r macro-enrichment, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=7, fig.cap="Enrichment of each TE macrocategory in promoters of DE genes. Fisher's exact test (one-sided, greater). Dashed line = p=0.05; * = BH-adjusted p<0.05. With full data, significant bars indicate TE families whose presence in promoters correlates with differential expression."}
if (!is.null(macro_enrich) && nrow(macro_enrich) > 0) {
  macro_enrich |>
    mutate(
      sig = ifelse(padj < 0.05, "*", ""),
      macrocategory = reorder(macrocategory, -log10(pvalue + 1e-10))
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=macrocategory, y=-log10(pvalue), fill=macrocategory)) +
    geom_col(show.legend=FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label=sig), vjust=-0.3, size=5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed",
               color="grey40", linewidth=0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_macro) +
    labs(title="Promoter TE macrocategory enrichment in DE genes",
         subtitle="Fisher's exact test; dashed = p=0.05; * = BH adj p<0.05",
         x=NULL, y="-log10(p-value)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1))
} else cat("Macrocategory enrichment not available.
")
```

# circRNA Analysis

## Detection Summary

```{r circ-summary}
if (!is.null(circ_annot) && nrow(circ_annot)>0) {
  kable(circ_annot |> arrange(desc(n_samples_detected)),
        caption="Detected circRNA loci after cross-sample merging (CIRI2, BWA-MEM, coordinate tolerance ±10bp). circ_type: CIRI2 classification (exonic, intronic, intergenic_region). n_samples_detected: samples with ≥2 supporting back-splice junction reads.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"))
} else {
  cat("No circRNA detected at current thresholds (min 2 junction reads per sample).\n")
}
```

## Junction Read Counts

```{r circ-counts}
if (!is.null(circ_counts) && nrow(circ_counts)>0) {
  kable(circ_counts,
        caption="Back-splice junction read counts per circRNA locus and sample. Each value is the number of chimeric reads spanning the back-splice junction.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"))
}
```

## Differential Expression

```{r circ-de}
if (!is.null(circ_de) && nrow(circ_de)>0) {
  circ_sig <- circ_de |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), padj<padj_thr, abs(log2FoldChange)>lfc_thr)

  show_df <- if (nrow(circ_sig)>0) {
    circ_sig |> arrange(padj)
  } else {
    circ_de |> arrange(pvalue)
  }

  cap <- if (nrow(circ_sig)>0) {
    sprintf("Significantly DE circRNA loci (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f). Wilcoxon rank-sum test with BH correction (n<3 per group). log2FoldChange = log2((mean_%s+1)/(mean_%s+1)).", padj_thr, lfc_thr, p$treatment, p$control)
  } else {
    sprintf("All tested circRNA loci (Wilcoxon rank-sum, BH correction). No loci reached significance thresholds (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f).", padj_thr, lfc_thr)
  }

  show_df |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric),~round(.,4))) |>
    kable(caption=cap) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"))
}
```

# TE Locus-Specific Analysis (M12)

## TEtranscripts

> TEtranscripts uses Expectation-Maximization to resolve multi-mapping reads between canonical gene loci and TE insertions simultaneously. The section below shows **only TE-derived features** (non-ENSG IDs). Canonical gene DE results are in Section 2.

```{r tet-results}
if (!is.null(tet_sig) && nrow(tet_sig) > 0) {
  if (!"gene_id" %in% colnames(tet_sig)) {
    tet_sig$feature_id <- rownames(tet_sig)
  } else {
    tet_sig$feature_id <- tet_sig$gene_id
  }

  # Separate TE features (non-ENSG) from canonical genes (ENSG)
  te_features <- tet_sig |>
    filter(!grepl("^ENSG", feature_id)) |>
    mutate(
      te_name   = sub(":.*", "", feature_id),
      te_family = sub("^[^:]+:([^:]+):.*", "\1", feature_id),
      te_class  = sub("^[^:]+:[^:]+:(.*)", "\1", feature_id),
      macro     = classify_macro(te_name)
    ) |>
    arrange(padj) |>
    select(TE=te_name, Family=te_family, Class=te_class, Macro=macro,
           any_of(c("baseMean","log2FoldChange","log2FoldChange_shrunk",
                    "pvalue","padj"))) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))

  canon_n <- sum(grepl("^ENSG", tet_sig$feature_id))
  te_n    <- nrow(te_features)

  cat(sprintf("TEtranscripts significant features: %d total (%d canonical genes, %d TE loci)
",
              nrow(tet_sig), canon_n, te_n))

  if (te_n > 0) {
    DT::datatable(
      te_features,
      caption=sprintf(
        "Significant TE-derived features from TEtranscripts (%s vs %s, padj<%.2f). %d canonical gene features excluded (see Section 2).",
        p$treatment, p$control, padj_thr, canon_n),
      options=list(pageLength=15, scrollX=TRUE,
                   dom="Bfrtip", buttons=c("csv","excel")),
      extensions="Buttons",
      rownames=FALSE
    )
  } else {
    cat("No significant TE-specific features at current thresholds.
")
    cat("(All TEtranscripts hits are canonical genes — shown in Section 2)
")
  }
} else {
  cat("No significant TEtranscripts features at current thresholds.")
}
```

# De Novo Transcripts (M16 — StringTie)

> StringTie assembled transcripts de novo from STAR-aligned BAM files, then merged across samples and compared to GENCODE v49 using gffcompare. Novel transcripts were quantified with `-e -b` and tested for differential expression using DESeq2 (proxy counts from FPKM x 10).


## Assembly Summary

```{r st-summary}
if (!is.null(st_summary)) {
  knitr::kable(st_summary,
    caption="StringTie de novo assembly summary. 'Exact match' = transcripts fully matching GENCODE annotation. Novel categories: j=new junction combination, i=novel intronic, u=novel intergenic, x=antisense to reference.",
    col.names=c("Metric","Count"),
    format.args=list(big.mark=",")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("StringTie summary not available.
")
```

```{r st-class-codes, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Distribution of gffcompare class codes. Red = novel or partially novel transcripts; blue = matching reference annotation. 'j' (new junction combination) are high-confidence novel isoforms sharing splice sites with known transcripts."}
if (!is.null(st_class_codes)) {
  st_class_codes |>
    mutate(
      label = paste0(class_code, "
", sub(" .*","",description)),
      label = reorder(label, n)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=label, y=n, fill=novel)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="#E74C3C","FALSE"="#85C1E9"),
                      labels=c("TRUE"="Novel","FALSE"="Annotated"), name=NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
    labs(title="StringTie transcript classification (gffcompare)",
         x="Class code", y="Number of transcripts") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
} else cat("Class code data not available.
")
```

## Novel Transcript DE

```{r novel-de-summary}
if (!is.null(novel_de)) {
  n_sig <- sum(!is.na(novel_de$padj) & novel_de$padj < padj_thr &
                 abs(novel_de$log2FoldChange) > lfc_thr, na.rm=TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("Novel transcripts tested: %d
", nrow(novel_de)))
  cat(sprintf("Significant (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f): %d
",
              padj_thr, lfc_thr, n_sig))
} else cat("Novel DE data not available.
")
```

```{r novel-de-volcano, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Volcano plot of novel transcript differential expression. Each point is a StringTie-assembled novel transcript not matching GENCODE annotation. Red = up-regulated in treatment; blue = down-regulated. Labels show transcript IDs of most significant events."}
if (!is.null(novel_de) && nrow(novel_de) > 0) {
  novel_de |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) |>
    mutate(
      sig = padj < padj_thr & abs(log2FoldChange) > lfc_thr,
      col = case_when(
        sig & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "UP",
        sig & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "DOWN",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      lab = ifelse(sig, t_name, NA)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj+1e-10), color=col)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=1.8) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label=lab), size=2.5,
                              max.overlaps=15, show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c(UP="#E74C3C",DOWN="#3498DB",NS="#BDC3C7"),
                       name=NULL) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr),
               linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(padj_thr),
               linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    labs(title="Novel transcript DE - volcano",
         subtitle=sprintf("%s vs %s", p$treatment, p$control),
         x=sprintf("log2FC (%s / %s)", p$treatment, p$control),
         y="-log10(padj)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
} else cat("Novel DE data not available.
")
```

```{r novel-de-table}
if (!is.null(novel_de) && nrow(novel_de) > 0) {
  novel_de |>
    filter(!is.na(padj)) |>
    arrange(padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) |>
    head(50) |>

      options=list(pageLength=15, scrollX=TRUE,

} else cat("Novel DE table not available.
")

# Differential Alternative Splicing (M17 — rMATS)

> rMATS quantified five classes of alternative splicing events from STAR-aligned BAM files: Skipped Exon (SE), Alternative 3'/5' Splice Site (A3SS/A5SS), Mutually Exclusive Exons (MXE), and Retained Intron (RI). deltaPSI = PSI(treatment) - PSI(control), where PSI (Percent Spliced In) ranges from 0 to 1.


## Event Summary

```{r splicing-summary, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Differential alternative splicing events by type. Positive bars = increased inclusion in treatment; negative bars = decreased inclusion (increased skipping/exclusion). deltaPSI threshold: 0.1."}
if (!is.null(splicing_summary)) {
  col_event <- c(SE="#E74C3C", A3SS="#3498DB", A5SS="#2ECC71",
                 MXE="#F39C12", RI="#9B59B6")
  label_event <- c(SE="Skipped Exon", A3SS="Alt 3' SS",
                   A5SS="Alt 5' SS", MXE="Mut. Excl.", RI="Ret. Intron")

  splicing_summary |>
    select(event_type, sig_enhanced, sig_skipped) |>
    pivot_longer(-event_type, names_to="direction", values_to="n") |>
    mutate(
      n = ifelse(direction=="sig_skipped", -n, n),
      direction = ifelse(direction=="sig_enhanced",
                         paste0("Increased in ", p$treatment),
                         paste0("Decreased in ", p$treatment))
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=event_type, y=n, fill=direction)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linewidth=0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("#E74C3C","#3498DB"), name=NULL) +
    labs(title="Differential splicing events by type",
         subtitle=sprintf("%s vs %s | |dPSI|>0.1", p$treatment, p$control),
         x="Event type", y="Significant events") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=13)
} else cat("Splicing summary not available.
")
```

```{r splicing-summary-table}
if (!is.null(splicing_summary)) {
  splicing_summary |>
    mutate(pct_sig=round(100*sig_events/total_events, 1)) |>
    select(Type=event_type, Description=description,
           Total=total_events, Significant=sig_events,
           `% sig`=pct_sig,
           `Increased`=sig_enhanced, `Decreased`=sig_skipped,
           `Mean |dPSI|`=mean_dpsi) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="Summary of differential splicing events per type.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("Splicing summary not available.
")
```

    arrange(pvalue) |>

    ggplot(aes(x=module, y=correlation, fill=correlation>0)) +

    geom_text(aes(y=ifelse(correlation>0, correlation+0.05, correlation-0.05),

    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linewidth=0.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="#E74C3C","FALSE"="#3498DB"), name=NULL,
                      labels=c("TRUE"="Higher in tumor","FALSE"="Higher in normal")) +
    labs(title="Module-condition correlation",
         subtitle="* = p<0.05", x="Module", y="Pearson r") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
  print(p1)
  wgcna_mt_cor |>
    arrange(pvalue) |>
    mutate(sig=ifelse(pvalue<0.05,"*",""),
           across(c(correlation,pvalue), ~round(.,4))) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="WGCNA module-condition correlation table.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("Module-trait correlation not available.\n")

# RNA Editing (M19 — JACUSA2)

> A-to-I RNA editing detected via JACUSA2 call-2 comparing normal vs tumor BAM files. A-to-I editing (adenosine-to-inosine, read as guanosine) is catalysed by ADAR enzymes and is dysregulated in many cancers.


## Editing Summary

```{r editing-summary}
if (!is.null(editing_summary) && nrow(editing_summary) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(editing_summary,
    col.names=c("Metric","Value"),
    caption="RNA A-to-I editing summary (JACUSA2). EF = editing frequency (edited reads / total reads). dEF = EF(tumor) - EF(normal).") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("RNA editing summary not available.
")
```

## Differential Editing

```{r editing-scatter, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Editing frequency in normal vs tumor samples. Each point is an A-to-I editing site. Red = increased editing in tumor; blue = decreased; grey = similar. Points above diagonal = higher editing in tumor."}
if (!is.null(editing_sites) && nrow(editing_sites) > 0) {
  editing_sites |>
    mutate(col=case_when(
      dEF >  0.1 ~ paste0("Increased in ",p$treatment),
      dEF < -0.1 ~ paste0("Decreased in ",p$treatment),
      TRUE        ~ "Similar")) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=EF1, y=EF2, color=col)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.6, size=1.5) +
    geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=0,linetype="dashed",color="grey50") +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#E74C3C","#3498DB","#BDC3C7"), name=NULL) +
    labs(title="A-to-I editing frequency: normal vs tumor",
         x=sprintf("EF (%s)", p$control),
         y=sprintf("EF (%s)", p$treatment)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=13)
} else cat("Editing site data not available.
")
```

# Metatranscriptomics (M20 — Kraken2/Bracken)

> Reads not mapping to the human reference genome (STAR unmapped) were classified taxonomically using Kraken2 v2.1.3 with the k2_minusb database. Bracken estimated species-level abundances. Homo sapiens reads excluded from microbial analysis.


## Classification Summary

```{r meta-classification}
if (!is.null(meta_summary)) {
  meta_summary |>
    mutate(pct_classified=paste0(pct_classified,"%")) |>
    select(Sample=sample_id, Condition=condition,
           `Total reads`=total_reads,
           `Classified`=classified,
           `% classified`=pct_classified) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="Kraken2 classification rates for unmapped reads.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("Metatranscriptomics summary not available.
")
```

## Microbial Composition

```{r meta-barplot, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, fig.cap="Relative abundance of microbial species in unmapped reads per sample (Homo sapiens excluded). With full data, oncogenic viruses (EBV, HPV, HBV) or tumor microbiome signatures may be detected here."}
if (!is.null(meta_abund) && nrow(meta_abund) > 0) {
  sample_cols <- coldata$sample_id[coldata$sample_id %in% colnames(meta_abund)]
  rel_df <- meta_abund |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(sample_cols),
                        names_to="sample_id", values_to="reads") |>
    left_join(coldata[,c("sample_id","condition")], by="sample_id") |>
    group_by(sample_id, condition) |>
    mutate(rel_abund=reads/sum(reads)*100) |>
    ungroup()

  top_taxa <- rel_df |>
    group_by(name) |>
    summarise(m=mean(rel_abund),.groups="drop") |>
    arrange(desc(m)) |> head(12) |> pull(name)

  rel_df |>
    mutate(taxon=ifelse(name %in% top_taxa, name, "Other")) |>
    group_by(sample_id, condition, taxon) |>
    summarise(rel_abund=sum(rel_abund),.groups="drop") |>
    ggplot(aes(x=sample_id, y=rel_abund, fill=taxon)) +
    geom_col(position="stack") +
    facet_wrap(~condition, scales="free_x") +
    labs(title="Microbial composition (unmapped reads)",
         x=NULL, y="Relative abundance (%)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30,hjust=1),
          legend.text=element_text(size=8))
} else cat("Microbial abundance data not available.
")
```


```{r meta-condition-barplot, fig.height=5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Mean microbial composition per condition."}
if (!is.null(meta_abund) && nrow(meta_abund) > 0) {
  sample_cols_m <- coldata$sample_id[coldata$sample_id %in% colnames(meta_abund)]
  cond_df <- meta_abund |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(sample_cols_m), names_to="sample_id", values_to="reads") |>
    mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id]) |>
    group_by(name, condition) |>
    summarise(mean_reads=mean(reads), .groups="drop") |>
    group_by(condition) |>
    mutate(rel_abund=mean_reads/sum(mean_reads)*100) |> ungroup()
  top_taxa_c <- cond_df |>
    group_by(name) |> summarise(m=mean(rel_abund),.groups="drop") |>
    arrange(desc(m)) |> head(12) |> pull(name)
  cond_df |>
    mutate(taxon=ifelse(name %in% top_taxa_c, name, "Other")) |>
    group_by(condition, taxon) |>
    summarise(rel_abund=sum(rel_abund),.groups="drop") |>
    ggplot(aes(x=condition, y=rel_abund, fill=taxon)) +
    geom_col(position="stack", width=0.6) +
    labs(title="Mean microbial composition by condition", x=NULL, y="Mean relative abundance (%)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) + theme(legend.text=element_text(size=8))
} else cat("Microbial data not available.\n")
```

```{r meta-diversity}
if (!is.null(meta_diversity)) {
  meta_diversity |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.,3)),
           condition=conditions[sample_id]) |>
    select(Sample=sample_id, Condition=condition,
           any_of(c("shannon","richness"))) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="Microbial alpha diversity metrics per sample.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
}
```

```{r meta-beta-pca, fig.height=5, fig.width=10, fig.cap="Beta diversity of microbial communities. Left: PCoA (Bray-Curtis dissimilarity) showing separation between samples. Right: heatmap of pairwise Bray-Curtis distances. With full data, tumor samples should cluster separately from normal if microbiome differs."}
if (!is.null(meta_abund) && nrow(meta_abund) > 0) {
  sample_cols_b <- coldata$sample_id[coldata$sample_id %in% colnames(meta_abund)]
  if (length(sample_cols_b) >= 3) {
    mat_b <- as.matrix(meta_abund[, sample_cols_b])
    # Bray-Curtis dissimilarity
    bc_dist <- if (requireNamespace("vegan", quietly=TRUE)) {
      as.matrix(vegan::vegdist(t(mat_b), method="bray"))
    } else {
      # Manual Bray-Curtis
      n <- ncol(mat_b)
      d <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames=list(sample_cols_b, sample_cols_b))
      for (i in 1:n) for (j in 1:n) {
        d[i,j] <- sum(abs(mat_b[,i]-mat_b[,j])) / sum(mat_b[,i]+mat_b[,j]+1e-10)
      }
      d
    }
    # PCoA
    pcoa <- cmdscale(bc_dist, k=2, eig=TRUE)
    var_exp <- round(pcoa$eig[1:2]/sum(abs(pcoa$eig))*100, 1)
    pcoa_df <- data.frame(
      sample_id=rownames(pcoa$points),
      PC1=pcoa$points[,1], PC2=pcoa$points[,2]
    ) |> mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id])

    p_pcoa <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2,
                                   color=condition, label=sample_id)) +
      geom_point(size=5, alpha=0.9) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size=3, show.legend=FALSE) +
      scale_color_manual(values=col_cond, name=NULL) +
      labs(title="PCoA - Bray-Curtis dissimilarity",
           x=paste0("PC1 (",var_exp[1],"%)"),
           y=paste0("PC2 (",var_exp[2],"%)")) +
      theme_minimal(base_size=12)

    p_heat <- bc_dist |> as.data.frame() |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("s1") |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-s1, names_to="s2", values_to="dist") |>
      ggplot(aes(x=s1, y=s2, fill=dist)) +
      geom_tile() +
      geom_text(aes(label=round(dist,2)), size=3) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="#E74C3C", name="BC dist") +
      labs(title="Bray-Curtis distance matrix", x=NULL, y=NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30,hjust=1))

    gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_pcoa, p_heat, ncol=2)
  } else {
    cat("Need >= 3 samples for beta diversity analysis.
")
  }
} else cat("Microbial abundance data not available.\n")
```

## Functional Profiling (M20b — HUMAnN3)

> HUMAnN3 profiles the functional capacity of microbial communities by mapping unmapped reads to the ChocoPhlAn nucleotide database and UniRef90 protein database. Outputs: gene family abundances (UniRef90 RPK), MetaCyc pathway abundances and coverage.


```{r humann-pathways}
if (!is.null(humann_paths) && nrow(humann_paths) > 0) {
  df <- humann_paths
  colnames(df) <- sub("_Unmapped[.]out_Abundance.*","", colnames(df))
  colnames(df)[1] <- "Pathway"
  df <- df[, !duplicated(colnames(df))]
  df_top <- df |>
    filter(!grepl("UNMAPPED|UNINTEGRATED", Pathway), !grepl("|", Pathway, fixed=TRUE)) |>
    mutate(mean_abund=rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm=TRUE)) |>
    arrange(desc(mean_abund)) |>
    head(20)
  if (nrow(df_top) > 0 && max(df_top$mean_abund, na.rm=TRUE) > 0) {
    df_top |> select(-mean_abund) |>
      DT::datatable(caption="Top 20 MetaCyc pathways (CPM).",
                    options=list(pageLength=10, scrollX=TRUE), rownames=FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("No pathway abundance detected with DEMO databases.
")
    cat("With full ChocoPhlAn + UniRef90, microbial metabolic pathways will appear here.
")
  }
} else {
  cat("HUMAnN3 pathway data not available — run M20b.
")
}
```

```{r humann-genes}
if (!is.null(humann_genes) && nrow(humann_genes) > 0) {
  df_g <- humann_genes
  colnames(df_g) <- sub("_Unmapped[.]out_Abundance.*","", colnames(df_g))
  colnames(df_g)[1] <- "Gene_Family"
  df_g <- df_g[, !duplicated(colnames(df_g))]
  df_g_top <- df_g |>
    filter(!grepl("UNMAPPED", Gene_Family), !grepl("|", Gene_Family, fixed=TRUE)) |>
    mutate(mean_rpk=rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm=TRUE)) |>
    arrange(desc(mean_rpk)) |>
    head(20)
  if (nrow(df_g_top) > 0 && max(df_g_top$mean_rpk, na.rm=TRUE) > 0) {
    df_g_top |> select(-mean_rpk) |>
      DT::datatable(caption="Top 20 gene families (RPK).",
                    options=list(pageLength=10, scrollX=TRUE), rownames=FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("No gene families detected with DEMO databases.
")
  }
} else {
  cat("HUMAnN3 gene family data not available.
")
}
```

# TE Somatic Insertions (M23)

> Soft-clipped sequences from STAR chimeric alignments were mapped to DFAM 3.9 TE consensus sequences using BWA-MEM. Clusters of TE-mapping clips at the same genomic locus represent candidate TE insertion sites. Somatic candidates = sites detected in tumor but not in normal samples.


## Insertion Summary

```{r te-insertion-summary}
if (!is.null(te_ins_summary)) {
  knitr::kable(te_ins_summary,
    col.names=c("Metric","Count"),
    caption="TE insertion detection summary (M23).") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("TE insertion summary not available.
")
```

## Insertion Clusters
```{r te-insertion-table}
if (!is.null(te_clusters) && nrow(te_clusters) > 0) {
  # Convert Python bool strings to R logical
  if ("somatic_candidate" %in% colnames(te_clusters) &&
      is.character(te_clusters$somatic_candidate))
    te_clusters$somatic_candidate <- te_clusters$somatic_candidate == "True"
  te_clusters |>
    arrange(desc(n_reads_total)) |>
    head(50) |>
    mutate(somatic = ifelse(somatic_candidate, "yes", "no")) |>
    select(any_of(c("chrom","start","end","te_family","te_macro",
                    "n_reads_total","n_normal","n_tumor",
                    "somatic","gene_name","dist"))) |>
    DT::datatable(
      caption=sprintf("TE insertion clusters (%d total).", nrow(te_clusters)),
      options=list(pageLength=15, scrollX=TRUE,
                   dom="Bfrtip", buttons=c("csv","excel")),
      extensions="Buttons", rownames=FALSE, filter="top")
} else cat("TE insertion cluster data not available.\n")
```

```{r te-somatic-plot, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, fig.cap="TE insertion clusters by macrocategory and condition. Points sized by supporting read count. Somatic candidates (tumor-only) highlighted."}
if (!is.null(te_clusters) && nrow(te_clusters) > 0) {
  te_clusters |>
    filter(!is.na(te_macro)) |>
    mutate(
      candidate = ifelse(
        (is.logical(somatic_candidate) & somatic_candidate) |
        (is.character(somatic_candidate) & somatic_candidate == "True"),
        "Somatic candidate", "Shared/normal"),
      size_val  = n_reads_total
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=te_macro, fill=candidate)) +
    geom_bar(position="dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("Somatic candidate"="#E74C3C",
                                "Shared/normal"="#85C1E9"),
                      name=NULL) +
    labs(title="TE insertion clusters by macrocategory",
         x=NULL, y="Number of clusters") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30,hjust=1))
} else cat("TE cluster data not available.
")
```

# Methods

## Reference Data

| Resource | Version/Date | Description |
|----------|-------------|-------------|
| GRCh38 | GENCODE v49 | Primary assembly, no patches |
| Gene annotation | GENCODE v49 GTF | 78,691 loci |
| TE consensus | DFAM 3.9 | 26,292 curated TE families |
| Genomic TE coordinates | UCSC RepeatMasker hg38 (Oct 2022) | 4,519,330 entries |

## Read Processing

Reads trimmed with fastp 0.22.0 (auto adapter detection, Q20, min length 36bp). Genome alignment: STAR 2.7.10b two-pass mode with GENCODE v49 splice site annotation (`--twopassMode Basic`, `--outReadsUnmapped Fastx`). Strandedness inferred per-sample with RSeQC infer_experiment.py. Gene counts: featureCounts (subread 2.0.6), `-t exon -g gene_id -s 2 --fracOverlap 0.1 -p --countReadPairs`. circRNA detection: STAR chimeric alignments (`--chimOutType SeparateSAMold`, `--chimSegmentMin 20`) → CIRI2 v2.0.6. Unmapped reads classified taxonomically with Kraken2 v2.1.3 (k2_minusb database) + Bracken abundance estimation. RNA editing: JACUSA2 v2.1.16 call-2 (`-P RF-FIRSTSTRAND`, `-filterNH 1`). TE somatic insertions: soft-clipped sequences from STAR chimeric SAM aligned to DFAM 3.9 TE consensus with BWA-MEM 0.7.18.

## TE Quantification — Pseudochromosome Approach

DFAM 3.9 human-clade TE families concatenated into pseudochromosomes (200N spacers between families). Trimmed R1 and R2 reads mapped independently (Bowtie2 `--very-sensitive-local`, default score-min). Fragment counts deduplicated by read name to avoid double-counting. Satellites: separate pseudochromosome with analogous approach. Locus-level: TEtranscripts 2.2.3 (EM multi-mapping, RepeatMasker hg38 GTF) + custom pysam locus counter.

## Differential Expression

DESeq2 1.50.2. Size factors from stable genes (CV<0.3, baseMean>10; fallback: baseMean>10 when <500 stable genes found). LFC shrinkage: ashr. TE/satellite: `independentFiltering=FALSE`. circRNA (n<3 per group): Wilcoxon rank-sum, BH correction.

## GO / Pathway Enrichment

clusterProfiler: `enrichGO` (BP/MF/CC), `enrichKEGG` (KEGG REST API, hsa), `enrichDO` (DOSE, Disease Ontology). ENSEMBL → ENTREZ mapping via `bitr` (org.Hs.eg.db). Universe: expressed genes (baseMean>0) for canonical genes; 51,934 RepeatMasker-intersected genes for TE host analysis. Gene set size: 10–500.
